{{Quote|Consider yourself lucky that I don't order my men to flay you alive from here to the Comra system, and then do something really awful to you.|[[Drixo]], to [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]|<ref name="SM3">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''</ref>}}
The '''Comra system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]], within the [[Dead Zone]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Comra/Legends|Comra]].
